designationHistory.indexText: The John D. Dingell, Jr. Conservation, Management, and Recreation Act established Jurassic National Monument in Emery County, Utah.

authority.citation: Public Law 116-9, title I, sec. 1252, 133 Stat. 580, 676

designationHistory.note: Established by statute, not under the Antiquities Act. The BLM unit page gives no designation date.

sources.name: 54 U.S.C. 320301 notes, national monuments list (Cornell LII)
